title: Unique Research: Kimi Chat Grew 20× in 5 Months — March Visits Set to Top 7.5M
summary: Since launching in October 2023, Moonshot AI’s Kimi Chat has stood out on long-context processing. By March 2024, traffic had surged — tech lead meeting product–market fit.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Traffic insight · March 22, 2024

Since launching in October 2023, Moonshot AI’s Kimi Chat has stood out on long-context processing. By March 2024, traffic had surged — tech lead meeting product–market fit.

Growth arc

  • Launch-era visits: ~156,000
  • February 2024: ~2.919M visits (+105.8% YoY as stated) — from ~156k to ~2.97M class over the arc
  • Context window: 200k → 2M Chinese characters — addressing information-integration pain
  • Mar 1–18, 2024 daily average visits: ~243,984 (Unique Research)
  • Unique Research forecast for full March 2024: 7.5M–9.0M visits (linear / average multiple applied to Feb base)

Roughly 20× growth over ~5 months from Oct launch through the Mar outlook.

Tech & infra

Transformer-attention tuned to weight key points across long context for coherence. Compute largely via ByteDance Volcano Engine / NVIDIA; pretrain cited at 10,000+ GPUs with public-cloud elastic scale.

Positioning & GTM

Centers on explosion-of-information users who need long-doc consolidation. Partnerships (e.g., iReader / Zhangyue, Huace Film & TV) expand scenarios; social, forums, and word-of-mouth drive acquisition; ongoing algo/service quality lifts retention.

Market color

Long-context demo (novels/books) may open publishing use cases. Related listed names (e.g., Yakun, Runze) flagged for Volcano collaboration / AI train–infer acceleration. Media/film ETFs hot on AI + short drama / mini-game narratives; 2024 Government Work Report “AI+” framing.

Outlook

Still an experience phase, not full commercialization — scale parameters, multimodal, faster text capability to raise retention. Competition remains; long context is the core wedge.

4 CN images/charts; attach on ingest.

— END —
